review_runs.novelty_method: ARS academic-research-suite guidance, Sider Scholar/OpenAlex discovery, primary publisher/arXiv/author texts, and bounded independent evidence checks. Search-index misses were demonstrated; a negative search is not a priority certificate. General factorial-ideal, resultant-periodicity and Gaussian carry proposals are known or routine. Uniform exact-d and integral Gaussian-ideal classifications remain candidates with novelty unverified.
